chunks: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: When a man and a woman are found in one quilt, they shall both be given a hundred lashes.

key_terms.جَلْدَة: A lash or stroke of the whip; one hundred lashes (مِائَةُ جَلْدَة) is the Quranic penalty for fornication (zina), here applied to the lesser offense of being found together in a quilt
key_terms.لِحَاف: A quilt or blanket shared in bed; sharing one quilt in this context implies illicit physical proximity between a non-mahram man and woman

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia Islam for a man and woman found in one quilt?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) rules that a man and woman found together under a single quilt are each to be punished with one hundred lashes. This hadith addresses a situation short of proven zina (fornication) but involving unlawful seclusion or proximity, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential principle that circumstances of immorality carry their own prescribed penalties. The ruling illustrates the strict Shia approach to sexual impropriety and the safeguarding of societal morals.
